description: Get the current status, title, completion timestamp, and full result notes for a specific delegated task. awaitingCustomerConfirm true means ask the human, then confirm_task, cancel_task, or reopen_task. amNote is the AM or VA note. deliverableLinks lists https links. Stop when status is completed, failed, or cancelled. Customer cancel is cancelled, not pending or in_progress, and it does not send the completion webhook.
name: get_task

awaitingCustomerConfirm.description: True means ask the human, then confirm_task, cancel_task, or reopen_task.

result.description: Full VA result when completed. Never invent this.

status.description: Stop polling on completed, failed, or cancelled.

title: Get delegated task
